# SmartToolzAI

> SmartToolzAI offers 36+ free online AI, business, finance, PDF, and developer tools running 100% client-side in your browser with zero signup, zero watermarks, and total privacy. Available in 6 languages (English, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, German, French).

## Pro Business, Finance & Creator Tools

- [Free PDF Invoice Generator](https://smarttoolzai.com/tools/invoice-generator.html): Create and download watermark-free PDF invoices in seconds with automatic tax & discount calculation.
- [PayPal & Stripe Fee Calculator](https://smarttoolzai.com/tools/paypal-fee-calculator.html): Calculate exact 2026 PayPal & Stripe fees, net payout, and reverse "Ask Client For" invoice amounts.
- [YouTube & TikTok Money Calculator](https://smarttoolzai.com/tools/youtube-money-calculator.html): Estimate daily, monthly, and annual creator ad revenue by niche RPM.
- [AI Prompt Generator & Optimizer (CO-STAR)](https://smarttoolzai.com/tools/ai-prompt-generator.html): Transform rough ideas into structured expert prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Midjourney.
- [Compound Interest & ROI Calculator](https://smarttoolzai.com/tools/compound-interest-calculator.html): Calculate future investment growth with monthly contributions and year-by-year breakdown tables.
- [JSON Formatter, Validator & Minifier](https://smarttoolzai.com/tools/json-formatter.html): Format, validate, and minify JSON payloads 100% locally in your browser.
